events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely passing, Tupac's influence on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track from a true legend?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the world lost guitar icon Jimi Hendrix. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still inspiring guitarists worldwide, Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with six strings. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That famous zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57 today. Still sounds as fresh as ever, doesn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Pretenders Legend
angles.copy: A true rock icon, Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders celebrates her 75th birthday today. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the legendary Oasis and solo frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher turns 54 today. What's your favourite anthem from the man himself? As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album: 55 Years On
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since its release, the message of John Lennon's 'Imagine' album still resonates globally. A powerful collection of songs.

events.title: The iPod: 25 Years of Portable Music
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember Your First iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, the original iPod dropped and changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating 007's cinematic debut in 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day. Which 007 theme tune gets your vote as the best?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and spirit of John Lennon. His music lives on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us countless laughs. Happy 87th birthday to a true British comedy legend!

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Timeless Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles delivered their sprawling 'White Album'. A masterpiece of diverse sounds and styles. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: A True Showman
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. A true legend never fades.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Influential Masterpiece
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, pushing musical boundaries. Which track from this seminal album is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since his passing, John Lennon's music and message continue to inspire. A profound loss, an enduring legacy.
